realizes.rationale: Emits the accessible clickable inline SVG Stage dependency mini-map and ordered Markdown dependency list derived from dag/dag.json.
Renders Concept Pages with VerificationBanner, visual figure, analogy-breaks callout, verbatim Lean anchors with upstream GitHub line links, related concepts, and automatic Stage/Concept backlinks.

1.note: `render_verification_banner` and `inject_verification_banner` serialize `VerificationStatus` into `<VerificationBanner />` and insert it idempotently after the first non-code H1.

2.note: `expand_stage_markers` expands `rh:lean-node` and `rh:stage-minimap` comments outside code spans with bounded verbatim Lean snippets, dynamic backtick fences and layered accessible SVG mini-maps, failing closed on unknown IDs or out-of-range lines.

3.note: `render_concept_page` deduplicates leading body H1s, resolves `lean_anchors` against `dag/dag.json`, omits self-references from the page glossary and renders analogy callouts, backlinks and sources.

4.note: `render_concepts_index` and `render_landing_index` emit deterministic alphabetical concept listings and the Stage 00 landing page with minimap, landmark links and pinned upstream commit.
